events.evidence: All three components (N, E, U) show an abrupt downward shift at index 449–450 relative to the normal fit, persisting through day 450 before a return begins afterward. The residual plots confirm a sustained offset in all components during this interval.

From index 451 onward, all components deviate from the historical normal and follow a new sustained displacement trajectory: N and E continue downward, U shows accelerated subsidence. The residuals remain consistently offset and trended until the end of the analysis period, with no arrest observed.
